description: Na₂Th(MoO₄)₃ is Zircon-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.54-2.65 Å. Th is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Th-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.46 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.83 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.77 Å) and two longer (1.85 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Th, and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Th, and one Mo atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Th, and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Th, and one Mo atom.
